name: video_analyze
description: Ask questions about 1-10 completed video creations: temporal questions, counting, artifact/continuity checks, and multi-video consistency comparison. Read-only — nothing is created, queued or charged. Use `mode: "shot_breakdown"` for structured pre-vis data instead of a free-text answer. Supports up to ~5 minutes of total footage per call; focus longer sources with `timeRangeSeconds` or `video_cut`.

creationIdentifiers.description: 1-10 completed video creation identifiers to analyze together.

mode.description: "answer" (default) for a free-text answer, or "shot_breakdown" for a structured shot-by-shot array (pre-vis data).

question.description: What to find out about the attached video(s).

timeRangeSeconds.description: Restrict analysis to a single time segment, applied to every attached video.

start.description: Segment start, in seconds from the start of each video.
